question: List Non-Small Cell Lung Nivolumab, Ipilimumab trials where overall follow‑up exceeded 21 months.

gemini.answer: This query retrieves the NCT, author, year, and PubMed ID for clinical trials involving Nivolumab and Ipilimumab in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) with an overall follow-up duration exceeding 21 months.
gemini.raw:
```json
{
  "sql": "SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"pubmed_id\" FROM public.\"clinical_trials\" WHERE \"cancer_type\" ILIKE '%NSCLC%' AND \"ici_name\" ILIKE '%Nivolumab%' AND \"ici_name\" ILIKE '%Ipilimumab%' AND \"follow_up_duration_overall_months\" > 21",
  "answer": "This query retrieves the NCT, author, year, and PubMed ID for clinical trials involving Nivolumab and Ipilimumab in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) with an overall follow-up duration exceeding 21 months.",
  "assumptions": ""
}
```
